seoTitle: Send Automatic Receipts & Renewal Emails in Stripe
metaDescription: Set up Stripe to automatically email receipts for payments and refunds, plus renewal reminders for subscriptions, so customers stay informed with no manual work.
intro: Manually emailing customers every time they pay or renew a subscription doesn't scale. This guide shows how to enable Stripe's built-in tools for sending automatic payment receipts and setting up renewal notifications, so subscribers always get confirmation without you lifting a finger.

steps.heading: Enable receipt emails in the Stripe dashboard
steps.body: Start in your dashboard's email settings and turn on automatic receipts so successful payments trigger a confirmation email right away.

steps.heading: Customize payment receipt settings
steps.body: Adjust the receipt content and appearance so it reflects your business rather than a generic default template.

steps.heading: Set up renewal emails for subscriptions
steps.body: For subscription billing, enable renewal notifications so customers get a heads-up or confirmation each time their plan renews.

steps.heading: Test receipts and renewal notifications
steps.body: Run through a test payment and renewal cycle to confirm the emails actually go out and look the way you expect before relying on them in production.

faq.question: Will Stripe send a receipt automatically after every payment?
faq.answer: Yes, once you enable the setting, Stripe automatically emails a receipt each time a payment succeeds.

faq.question: Can I get renewal reminders for subscriptions too?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe can send renewal notifications so subscribers know when their subscription payment has processed for another billing cycle.

faq.question: Do I need to write my own email templates?
faq.answer: No, Stripe provides built-in templates you can customize, so you don't need a separate email tool to send these confirmations.

faq.question: How do I know the receipts are working correctly?
faq.answer: Testing a payment and a renewal cycle before going live is the best way to confirm the emails are sent and formatted correctly.
